description: This file defines the interface for temperature management in a device. It includes function declarations for getting current temperature, setting and getting temperature thresholds, and defines related enums and typedefs.

methods.name: mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current temperature state and raw temperature value of the core, along with Wi-Fi temperature.

methods.name: mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds to determine when high and critical temperature states are reported.

methods.name: mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves the current temperature thresholds for high and critical temperature states.

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_CRITICAL       \/* Temp is critical, should trigger a thermal reset *\/$/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_HIGH,          \/* Temp is high, but just a warning as device can still opera/

ctags.name: mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL
ctags.pattern: /^    mfrTEMPERATURE_NORMAL = 0,    \/* Temp is within normal operating range *\/$/
